moisture_pct.quote: fresh cow milk paneer P0 chemical constituents were 50.78 g of moisture, 0.22% of acidity, 5.3 of pH, 20.39 g of protein, 22.8 g of fat

fat_pct.quote: fresh cow milk paneer P0 chemical constituents were 50.78 g of moisture, 0.22% of acidity, 5.3 of pH, 20.39 g of protein, 22.8 g of fat

ph.quote: 50.78 g of moisture, 0.22% of acidity, 5.3 of pH

ammonia.reason: No proteolysis or deamination in fresh unripened curd, so no free NH3 accumulates.

animal_barnyard.reason: Clean pasteurized cow milk with no washed-rind bacteria, so no p-cresol/indole barnyard notes.

bitter.reason: No rennet or ripening proteolysis, so no accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation or blue ripening, so no methyl ketone mold pathway.

browning.reason: Residual lactose 2-2.7% plus milk proteins give active Maillard browning when fried.

buttery.reason: No starter citrate fermentation or ripening, so minimal diacetyl/acetoin from milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: No lipase ripening or lipolysis, so very low free butanoic/hexanoic sweaty acids.

creaminess.reason: High moisture ~51% and ~23% fat give soft mouthfeel but heat-denatured proteins limit creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Acid-heat precipitation at pH 5.3 near casein isoelectric point gives short crumbly fracture with no ripening.

firmness.reason: Heat-denatured whey-casein complex pressed after 85-90C coagulation forms dense firm non-elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: No phenylalanine catabolism by yeasts/molds, so minimal phenylacetaldehyde/phenylethanol.

fruity.reason: No esterase activity or aging for ethyl ester synthesis, so almost no ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks high 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goat acids, so no goaty note.

malty_nutty.reason: High-heat milk treatment promotes mild Strecker aldehydes and lactones perceived as sweet-nutty.

melt.reason: Acid-heat whey-casein complex and low pH prevent casein flow, so it holds shape when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Penicillium/Galactomyces metabolism, so no 1-octen-3-ol earthy pathway.

oil_off.reason: Denatured protein matrix entraps fat and does not flow, so almost no free oil release on heating.

smoky.reason: Plain paneer is not smoked, so no guaiacol/syringol deposition from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Direct organic acid coagulation with lime/citric acid plus pH 5.3 gives mild acidic-vinegar tang.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching or aligned micellar network, acid curd fractures instead of stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Milk heated to 85-90C denatures beta-lactoglobulin releasing H2S and cooked-milk sulfhydryls.

sweet.reason: Entrapped residual lactose 2-2.7% with no fermentation gives characteristic sweetish whey note.

umami.reason: No prolonged proteolysis to release glutamate peptides, so very low umami brothiness.
